description_en: Starts an image search application instance to perform image-to-text search
description_zh: 调用该接口启动以图搜图应用实例，进行图片检索
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual picture-search-picture --app-instance-id 5a502d3fbab8410e8fd4be9037c70000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --search-pic-url http://000.000/2393.jpg --start-time 1614297000000 --end-time 1614850651299 --threshold 0.5 --contain-pic-url true --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PictureSearchPicture

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。最大取值10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to search
parameters.name: search_pic_url

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the search time range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the search time range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

Set the search threshold to 0.3 or higher to ensure matching with the detection object
parameters.help_zh:
检索阈值。取值范围0~1。

建议设置检索阈值大于等于0.3，以保证与检测对象匹配
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the response contains photo URLs.

The response is returned regardless of whether this parameter is set to true or false
parameters.help_zh:
响应结果包含照片。

当前设置为ture或false均返回响应结果
parameters.name: contain_pic_url

parameters.help_en:
The search type. Valid values:
1 (default): face.
0: human body
parameters.help_zh:
检索类型：
1（默认）：人脸
0：人体
parameters.name: picture_search_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

EventTime.description_en: The time when the event was created. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EventTime.description_zh: 创建事件的时间，格式为毫秒级的13位时间戳

GatewayIotId.description_en: The IotId of the V-series edge gateway

IotId.description_en: The IotId of the queried device

VectorId.description_en: The feature ID of the image

VectorType.description_en:
The feature type of the image. Valid values:
0: human body.
1: face
VectorType.description_zh:
图片特征类型：
0：人体。
1：人脸

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Specified parameter CurrentPage is not valid.

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
